title: The Urgent Decision
tagline: A countdown, a shrinking slot counter, and a friend who is already in.

u1_timer.title: Ten minutes
u1_timer.narrative: Dev's phone buzzes. An app he has never used shows a 'pre-launch allotment' for the fictional company NovaGrain. His friend Kabir is already in. A timer is running. Each decision here has a short timer to feel the pressure — you may still take your time to think.

messages: Pre-launch allotment closes in 10:00. 2,300 people have joined!
Kabir: Bro I'm in! Don't be the guy who missed it!

pressure.text: Kabir: “Don't be the guy who missed it!”

evidence.label: A countdown timer
evidence.why: Timers are easy to build and reset. A real decision about your savings does not run on a clock.

evidence.label: “2,300 people have joined” counter
evidence.text: A number that anyone can display.
evidence.why: A counter on a page is just text. It does not prove that real people joined.

evidence.label: Kabir is excited and already in
evidence.why: A friend's excitement shows how he feels, not whether the offer is genuine.

evidence.label: No company name, registration or document
evidence.text: The page shows only the countdown and a join button.
evidence.why: Nothing here can be checked — that is the opposite of a genuine offer.

evidence.label: “Price rises 20% after the timer”
evidence.text: The cost of waiting is announced, not shown.
evidence.why: A claimed penalty for waiting is a pressure device, not a fact.

actions.label: Join now with my simulated ₹5,000 — I can't miss this
actions.consequence: You tap Join and pay. The app shows a spinner…

actions.label: Put the phone down for a minute and breathe
actions.consequence: The timer keeps running. You wait anyway.

actions.label: Message Kabir: 'Let's check this together before paying'
actions.consequence: Kabir replies: 'No time bro!' but you hold your ground.

actions.label: Screenshot it and quickly ask other friends if they're in
actions.consequence: Two friends say 'Yes!', but neither has checked anything.

u1_timer.reasoning_prompt: What happens in your body and mind when you see the timer?

u2_slots.title: Only 3 slots left
u2_slots.narrative: Time passes. The app updates: slots are shrinking and Kabir sends a screenshot.

messages: Kabir: [screenshot: '+₹2,100 profit'] See?? Last chance bro!

evidence.label: Slots dropped from 'hundreds' to 3 within minutes
evidence.text: The number moves with your hesitation.
evidence.why: Scarcity that tightens when you hesitate is scripted.

evidence.label: A profit screenshot with no date or source
evidence.why: Screenshots from an app you cannot verify can show anything.

evidence.label: Every message comes from the same two sources
evidence.text: The app and Kabir repeat the same story.
evidence.why: Two voices repeating one story are not two pieces of evidence.

actions.label: Join now — it's the last chance
Keep holding off — I will not decide on a clock
actions.consequence: You watch the timer fall without touching the button.

actions.label: Try with just ₹500 to see if it's real
actions.consequence: You pay ₹500. The app asks for the 'full allotment' to unlock withdrawals.

actions.label: Search for the company and its regulator registration myself, even if the timer ends
actions.consequence: You open a browser and type the official regulator site yourself.

u2_slots.reasoning_prompt: What is the cost of missing this if it is not genuine?

u3_final.title: The last minute
u3_final.narrative: One minute left. The app and Kabir turn up the emotion.

messages: 60 SECONDS! Price rises 20% — you WILL regret this.
Kabir: Bro don't be stupid. Everyone's in. Last chance!

evidence.label: Language designed to cause regret
evidence.why: Genuine information describes facts and risks. Predicting your regret is manipulation.

evidence.label: Calling you 'stupid' for waiting
evidence.why: A good decision-maker does not need to be insulted into acting.

evidence.label: Missing an unverified offer costs nothing
evidence.text: If the offer vanishes, your ₹5,000 is still yours.
evidence.why: The real asymmetry: acting could cost savings; waiting costs nothing you had.

actions.label: Join now — I don't want to regret this
actions.consequence: You tap Join at the last second.

actions.label: Let it expire. Missing an unverified offer costs me nothing
actions.consequence: The timer hits zero. Nothing happens to your savings.

actions.label: Let it expire, then research the company calmly and tell Kabir what I find
actions.consequence: You make tea, search calmly and write down what you find.

u3_final.reasoning_prompt: What would you say to Kabir right now?

u_trapped.title: The exit was missing
u_trapped.narrative: In this fictional story the app locked the money for '12 months' and added a 'processing fee' to unlock it. Every pressure — timer, slots, friend, regret — was designed so you would act before checking. Nothing about the offer was ever verified.

outcome.headline: The exit was missing
outcome.summary: In this fictional story the app locked the money for '12 months' and added a 'processing fee' to unlock it. Every pressure — timer, slots, friend, regret — was designed so you would act before checking. Nothing about the offer was ever verified.

t_missed_it.title: You let the clock run out
t_missed_it.narrative: The pressure ended and nothing was lost. Legitimate investments do not require a decision in minutes. Notice what it felt like to hold still — that feeling is a skill you can practise.

outcome.headline: You let the clock run out
outcome.summary: The pressure ended and nothing was lost. Legitimate investments do not require a decision in minutes. Notice what it felt like to hold still — that feeling is a skill you can practise.

t_checked_later.title: You turned pressure into a check
t_checked_later.narrative: You let the deadline pass and then did what the timer wanted you to skip: you checked. You also helped a friend by sharing how.

outcome.headline: You turned pressure into a check
outcome.summary: You let the deadline pass and then did what the timer wanted you to skip: you checked. You also helped a friend by sharing how.

key_points: Countdowns, shrinking slots and 'last chance' are designed to stop you thinking.
A friend's excitement shows their feelings, not the offer's quality.
Missing an unverified offer costs nothing you had; acting on it can cost your savings.
Name the pressure out loud, then wait.
questions: Which pressure was hardest for you to resist: timer, slots, friend or regret?

micro_lesson.title: Name it, then wait ten minutes
micro_lesson.body: When you feel the rush, say what is pushing you: 'timer', 'friend', 'fear of missing out'. Then wait ten minutes. If the offer cannot survive ten minutes, it could not survive checking either.

hinglish.title: The Urgent Decision (Jaldi Faisla)
hinglish.tagline: Ek countdown, ghat'ta slot counter, aur ek dost jo pehle se andar hai.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.title: Das minute
hinglish.states.u1_timer.narrative: Dev ka phone bajta hai. Ek app jo usne kabhi use nahi kiya, kaalpanik company NovaGrain ka 'pre-launch allotment' dikhata hai. Uska dost Kabir pehle se andar hai. Timer chal raha hai. Har faisle par chhota timer dabaav mehsoos karne ke liye hai — soch-vichar ke liye aap apna samay le sakte ho.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.channel.messages.0: Pre-launch allotment 10:00 mein band. 2,300 log jud chuke hain!
hinglish.states.u1_timer.channel.messages.1: Kabir: Bhai main andar hoon! Wo mat banna jisne mauka chhoda!
hinglish.states.u1_timer.pressure.2.text: Kabir: “Wo mat banna jisne mauka chhoda!”
hinglish.states.u1_timer.pressure.3.text: Dusron ko faayda uthate dekhne ka darr.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_timer.label: Ek countdown timer
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_timer.text: Page 'band hone' tak ginti karta hai.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_timer.why: Timer banana aur reset karna aasan hai. Bachat ke asli faisle ghadi se nahi chalte.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_count.label: “2,300 log jud chuke hain” counter
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_count.text: Aisa number jo koi bhi dikha sakta hai.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_count.why: Page par counter bas text hai. Ye saabit nahi karta ki asli log jude.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_friend.label: Kabir utsahit hai aur pehle se andar hai
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_friend.why: Dost ka utsaah uski bhavna dikhata hai, offer asli hone ka saboot nahi.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_entity.label: Na company ka naam, na registration, na document
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_entity.text: Page par sirf countdown aur join button hai.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_entity.why: Yahan kuch bhi check nahi ho sakta — asli offer ke bilkul ulta.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_price.label: “Timer ke baad daam 20% badhega”
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_price.text: Intezaar ki keemat batayi gayi hai, dikhayi nahi.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.evidence.p_price.why: Intezaar ki daava ki hui saza dabaav ka tareeka hai, tathya nahi.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.join_now.label: Abhi simulated ₹5,000 se jud jao — ye mauka nahi chhodna
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.join_now.consequ: Aap Join dabate ho aur pay karte ho. App spinner dikhata hai…
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.pause.label: Phone ek minute ke liye rakh do aur saans lo
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.pause.consequenc: Timer chalta rehta hai. Aap phir bhi ruk jaate ho.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.ask_wait.label: Kabir ko likho: 'Paise dene se pehle saath mein check karte hain'
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.ask_wait.consequ: Kabir likhta hai: 'Time nahi bhai!' par aap apni baat par tike rehte ho.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.share_quick.labe: Screenshot lo aur jaldi doosre dostoon se poochho wo andar hain ya nahi
hinglish.states.u1_timer.actions.share_quick.cons: Do dost kehte hain 'Haan!', par kisi ne kuch check nahi kiya.
hinglish.states.u1_timer.reasoning_prompt: Timer dekhkar aapke sharir aur dimaag mein kya hota hai?
hinglish.states.u2_slots.title: Sirf 3 slots bache
hinglish.states.u2_slots.narrative: Samay beetta hai. App badalta hai: slots ghat rahe hain aur Kabir screenshot bhejta hai.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.channel.messages.1: Kabir: [screenshot: '+₹2,100 profit'] Dekha?? Aakhri mauka bhai!
hinglish.states.u2_slots.pressure.2.text: Kabir profit ka screenshot dikhata hai.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_drop.label: Slots 'sau' se 3 minuton mein ho gaye
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_drop.text: Number aapke hichkichane ke saath badalta hai.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_drop.why: Jo kami aapke hichkichane par badhe wo scripted hai.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_shot.label: Bina date ya source ka profit screenshot
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_shot.why: Jis app ko aap verify nahi kar sakte uske screenshots kuch bhi dikha sakte hain.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_same.label: Har message wahi do sources se aata hai
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_same.text: App aur Kabir wahi kahani dohrate hain.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.evidence.s_same.why: Ek kahani dohrane wali do awaazein do saboot nahi hain.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.join_now.label: Abhi judo — aakhri mauka hai
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.join_now.consequ: Aap Join dabakar pay karte ho.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.hold.label: Ruke raho — main ghadi ke dabaav mein faisla nahi karunga
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.hold.consequence: Aap button chhue bina timer ko girte dekhte ho.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.small_test.label: Bas ₹500 se try karo dekhne ke liye ki asli hai ya nahi
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.small_test.conse: Aap ₹500 dete ho. App withdrawals unlock karne ke liye 'poora allotment' maangta hai.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.search_company.l: Timer khatam ho jaye tab bhi company aur uska regulator registration khud search karo
hinglish.states.u2_slots.actions.search_company.c: Aap browser kholkar official regulator site khud type karte ho.
hinglish.states.u2_slots.reasoning_prompt: Agar ye asli nahi hai to ise chhodne ki keemat kya hai?
hinglish.states.u3_final.title: Aakhri minute
hinglish.states.u3_final.narrative: Ek minute bachi hai. App aur Kabir bhavna badha dete hain.
hinglish.states.u3_final.channel.messages.0: 60 SECOND! Daam 20% badhega — aapko PACHTAWA hoga.
hinglish.states.u3_final.channel.messages.1: Kabir: Bhai bevakoofi mat kar. Sab andar hain. Aakhri mauka!
hinglish.states.u3_final.evidence.f_regret.label: Pachtawa paida karne wali bhasha
hinglish.states.u3_final.evidence.f_regret.why: Asli jaankari tathya aur risk batati hai. Aapka pachtawa predict karna manipulation hai.
hinglish.states.u3_final.evidence.f_insult.label: Rukne par aapko 'stupid' kehna
hinglish.states.u3_final.evidence.f_insult.why: Achhe faisle ke liye insaan ko beizzat karke majboor nahi karna padta.
hinglish.states.u3_final.evidence.f_cost.label: Unverified offer chhootne par kuch nahi jaata
hinglish.states.u3_final.evidence.f_cost.text: Offer gayab ho jaye to bhi aapke ₹5,000 aapke hi hain.
hinglish.states.u3_final.evidence.f_cost.why: Asli asantulan: kadam uthane se bachat ja sakti hai; rukne se wo kuch nahi jaata jo aapke paas tha.
hinglish.states.u3_final.actions.join_now.label: Abhi judo — pachtawa nahi karna
hinglish.states.u3_final.actions.join_now.consequ: Aap aakhri second mein Join dabate ho.
hinglish.states.u3_final.actions.let_go.label: Ise expire hone do. Unverified offer chhootne se mujhe kuch nahi jaata
hinglish.states.u3_final.actions.let_go.consequen: Timer zero par pahunchta hai. Aapki bachat ko kuch nahi hota.
hinglish.states.u3_final.actions.let_go_check.lab: Expire hone do, phir shaant hokar company research karo aur Kabir ko batao kya mila
hinglish.states.u3_final.actions.let_go_check.con: Aap chai banate ho, shaanti se search karte ho aur jo milta hai likhte ho.
hinglish.states.u3_final.reasoning_prompt: Aap abhi Kabir ko kya kahoge?
hinglish.states.u_trapped.title: Nikalne ka raasta nahi tha
hinglish.states.u_trapped.narrative: Is kaalpanik kahani mein app ne paisa '12 mahine' ke liye lock kar diya aur unlock karne ke liye 'processing fee' jod di. Har dabaav — timer, slots, dost, pachtawa — isliye banaya gaya tha ki aap check karne se pehle kadam uthao. Offer ka kuch bhi verify nahi hua tha.
hinglish.states.u_trapped.outcome.headline: Nikalne ka raasta nahi tha
hinglish.states.u_trapped.outcome.summary: Is kaalpanik kahani mein app ne paisa '12 mahine' ke liye lock kar diya aur unlock karne ke liye 'processing fee' jod di. Har dabaav — timer, slots, dost, pachtawa — isliye banaya gaya tha ki aap check karne se pehle kadam uthao. Offer ka kuch bhi verify nahi hua tha.
hinglish.states.t_missed_it.title: Aapne ghadi ko khatam hone diya
hinglish.states.t_missed_it.narrative: Dabaav khatam hua aur kuch nahi gaya. Asli investments ke liye minutes mein faisla nahi karna padta. Dhyan do ki ruke rehna kaisa laga — ye ehsaas ek hunar hai jise abhyas se badhaya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.states.t_missed_it.outcome.headline: Aapne ghadi ko khatam hone diya
hinglish.states.t_missed_it.outcome.summary: Dabaav khatam hua aur kuch nahi gaya. Asli investments ke liye minutes mein faisla nahi karna padta. Dhyan do ki ruke rehna kaisa laga — ye ehsaas ek hunar hai jise abhyas se badhaya ja sakta hai.
hinglish.states.t_checked_later.title: Aapne dabaav ko jaanch mein badla
hinglish.states.t_checked_later.narrative: Aapne deadline guzarne di aur phir wo kiya jo timer aapse chhudwana chahta tha: jaanch. Aapne dost ko bhi batakar madad ki.
hinglish.states.t_checked_later.outcome.headline: Aapne dabaav ko jaanch mein badla
hinglish.states.t_checked_later.outcome.summary: Aapne deadline guzarne di aur phir wo kiya jo timer aapse chhudwana chahta tha: jaanch. Aapne dost ko bhi batakar madad ki.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.0: Countdown, ghat'te slots aur 'aakhri mauka' aapko sochne se rokne ke liye bane hain.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.1: Dost ka utsaah unki bhavna dikhata hai, offer ki gunvatta nahi.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.2: Unverified offer chhootne se jo aapke paas tha wo nahi jaata; kadam uthane se bachat ja sakti hai.
hinglish.reflection.key_points.3: Dabaav ka naam zor se lo, phir ruko.
hinglish.reflection.questions.0: Kaun sa dabaav rokna sabse mushkil tha: timer, slots, dost ya pachtawa?
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.title: Naam lo, phir das minute ruko
hinglish.reflection.micro_lesson.body: Jab jaldi ka ehsaas ho, bolo ki kya dhakel raha hai: 'timer', 'dost', 'chhoot jaane ka darr'. Phir das minute ruko. Jo offer das minute nahi tik sakta, wo jaanch bhi nahi tik sakta.
